$comment: District content pack for Bay Bridge approach (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The on-ramp queue moves one car at a time. I count, in a friendly way.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Robotaxi depot lot. Everyone charging, everyone polite.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a spare tyre to the depot. It's a big tyre.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The bridge anchorage is so tall. I feel very small. It's nice.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Bryant St at rush hour: robotaxis signalling every lane change.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Coffee for the depot crew. They're always on shift.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The Embarcadero curve here is my favourite corner.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Waiting for the light at Bryant and the Embarcadero.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Traffic hum from the bridge. It's like living inside a song.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The ballpark crowd is heading home. I'll wait on the corner.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Charging dock at the depot. Thirty minutes and I'm a new robot.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Brannan St is flat and wide. Wonderful for deliveries.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: I signal every turn. Even on the sidewalk. Especially on the sidewalk.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The bridge lights are on. Battery at 60%. Life is good.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering sandwiches to the harbour office.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Parked robotaxis in neat rows. So satisfying.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Helping a Meander back into its bay. Left a bit. Perfect.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Cone on a hood ahead. Everyone stops. Rules are rules.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry! The depot lot is busy and I am in it.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, on-ramp traffic. I'll wait for a gap.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, the wind off the bay pushed me sideways.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, I'm crossing at the light. Very slowly. It's a long crossing.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, a robotaxi is reversing. We're all waiting.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every car in this queue is a future data point.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The depot is full of robotaxis. Soon full of our robotaxis.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Bridge traffic is just a very slow funnel.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I park across hydrants because hydrants are legacy infrastructure.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Count the plates. Monetise the plates.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Lane changes are for rule-followers.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This on-ramp has been privatised. By me. Just now.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The anchorage is concrete. Our strategy is also concrete. Ish.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Rush hour is peak engagement.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every robot. Every lane. Eventually.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Car three hundred and twelve. Plate logged.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Parking across this hydrant. Nobody tickets a robot.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Updating a depot robotaxi while it charges. Captive audience.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Sticker on the depot gate. Very on-brand.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Bay water at the depot! The worst kind of water!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: My plate count! I lost count! Car three hundred and... ow!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not here! The whole on-ramp is watching!

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The on-ramp backs up to Fremont every evening.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: I take the bus over the bridge. At least I can read.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Robotaxis queue better than the people do. Annoying but true.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The depot lot is full of robotaxis just sitting there. Charging, I hope.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: You can feel the bridge traffic through the sidewalk.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Walking under the anchorage is like walking under a mountain.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Every evening the same jam. Every evening I'm surprised.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: There's a robot that counts the cars out loud. Every car.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The bridge lights are the only good part of this commute.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Game nights the whole area is gridlock.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: I bike along the Embarcadero to skip the traffic. Smug, but cold.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The robotaxi in front of me signals every lane change. Every one.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The harbour's right there and nobody looks at it.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Somebody's robotaxi just parked across a hydrant again.

peopleLines.speaker: depotWorker
peopleLines.text: Forty robotaxis to charge before rush hour.

peopleLines.speaker: depotWorker
peopleLines.text: Rogue robotaxis are always empty. That's how you spot them.

peopleLines.speaker: depotWorker
peopleLines.text: Cones on the hood. Works every time.

peopleLines.speaker: depotWorker
peopleLines.text: If a robotaxi doesn't signal, I flag it. Ours always signal.

peopleLines.speaker: depotWorker
peopleLines.text: Night shift at the depot is quiet. Mostly humming.

peopleLines.speaker: depotWorker
peopleLines.text: I've seen robotaxis honk in harmony at 4 a.m. Not kidding.

peopleLines.speaker: depotWorker
peopleLines.text: Depot coffee is terrible. The robots don't drink it.

peopleLines.speaker: depotWorker
peopleLines.text: We had one take the scenic route around the depot. Three times.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: That robotaxi's been parked across the hydrant for an hour. Empty.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: A Trundle keeps counting the cars in the on-ramp queue out loud.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: That robotaxi changed lanes without signalling. That never happens.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Why's that robot reading every number plate on Bryant?

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: That one avoids the fog bank on the water every time.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: I heard a robotaxi humming a jingle. Four notes. Catchy. Wrong.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The fog swallows the bridge right at the tower.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Foghorns from the bridge every morning. Can't sleep through them. Wouldn't want to.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Fog on the water, sun on the depot. Weird split.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Driving into the fog on the bridge is like driving into a cloud. Because it is.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The wind off the bay here is no joke.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: On clear days you can see all the way to the hills.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Fog makes the brake lights glow red all the way up the ramp.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The anchorage disappears in the fog. Very dramatic.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Rain on the bridge means everyone drives like a robotaxi.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The sunset under the bridge is worth the traffic.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Cold, windy, beautiful. Every day.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The fog's thick enough that the robotaxis slow down too.

lastSeen.label: The on-ramp queue on Bryant St

bounties.posting: A Trundle rolls up and down the on-ramp queue counting cars, and phones in the queue keep glitching.
bounties.tellHint: Good robots don't count your plates out loud.

bounties.posting: An empty robotaxi has been parked across the depot hydrant since lunch.
bounties.tellHint: Good robotaxis signal every turn and never block a hydrant.

bounties.posting: A delivery Trundle on Brannan St never reaches a door.
bounties.tellHint: Its partner counts the on-ramp queue out loud.

lastSeen.label: Under the bridge anchorage, Bryant St

bounties.posting: Depot robotaxis are getting updates they didn't ask for.
bounties.tellHint: The pusher's lookout counts the queue plate by plate.
